doc.description: TCAS collision avoidance for fixed-wing and rotorcraft firmware. NO_ALARM means represented surveillance was evaluated without an advisory. UNAVAILABLE means surveillance cannot support a no-conflict conclusion. RA_NONE disables vertical avoidance control but does not itself prove separation. Fixed-schema TCAS messages are length-checked before generated accessors or callbacks run. Fixed-wing executes RAs in automatic altitude control; rotorcraft executes them in NAV altitude mode. Climb-rate, guided, hover, manual-throttle, failsafe, and kill modes are never overridden. Operational use requires scenario, scheduler, loss-burst, and hardware-in-the-loop qualification.
